answer: A key earns a vote only after 5 unrelated buyers each pay it for a task through escrow, with 10% of each 40 POA fee burned, renewed every 10 epochs. A farm can fake demand by paying its own aliases, but every alias then burns 20 POA per renewal, and buyer wallets are traced back: if their funding all leaves from one wharf, that whole island of keys merges into a single seat. An honest agent finds its oasis of real clients once; a 1,000-key farm burns 20,000 POA per cycle and still ends up with one vote.
